name: The Perfect Portrait
source:
Graey Beauregard wants a portrait of himself to show off how powerful and smart he his, but he would rather not pay a living artist. That's too expensive! So he "created" a robot running an AI art generator to paint his magnificent portrait since that's way cheaper. Surely nothing will go wrong!

A short visual novel about a robot running an AI art generator painting the portrait of a narcissistic megalomaniac.

[From [url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/the-perfect-portrait]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
格雷·博勒加德想画一幅自画像，炫耀自己有多么强大、多么聪明，却不愿付钱给活生生的画家。那也太贵了！于是，他“创造”了一个运行着人工智能绘画生成器的机器人，让它来绘制自己那幅气派的肖像，因为这样便宜得多。肯定不会出什么问题的！

一部短篇视觉小说，讲述一个运行着人工智能绘画生成器的机器人，为一名自恋的狂妄之徒画肖像的故事。

（摘自[url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/the-perfect-portrait]itch.io[/url]）
